legend: The tumour shows vaguely corded to diffuse architecture and ovoid nuclei with high-grade atypia. There are scattered multinucleated giant cells. Although these features are compatible with an SCST lineage, they are not characteristic of a specific SCST type.
Inhibin is focally positive supporting an SCST.

This metastatic tumour involving the omentum is composed predominantly of diffuse sheets of pleomorphic cells with scattered multinucleated giant cells and hemorrhage, particularly in the central areas. Toward the periphery, the tumour shows a vaguely corded to diffuse architecture with ovoid nuclei exhibiting high-grade atypia. Immunohistochemically, the tumor is positive for sex cord-stromal markers, including patchy inhibin, diffuse SF1, and patchy calretinin. Although these findings support sex cord-stromal tumor (SCST) lineage, the morphologic and immunophenotypic features are not characteristic of a specific SCST subtype.
